raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 27 surplus rows (4854 rows vs 4827 distinct txn_id), and the 27 record_version=2 rows are re-deliveries of existing transactions. silver_transactions keeps every version and then filters on status, so duplicate txn_ids survive and flow into the gold tables; the fix is to keep only the latest version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter. Two txn_ids may tie at version 2, so the batch_id and ingest_ts tie-breakers are a best effort and should be confirmed with the source team.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, batch_id DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
